verdict.rationale: Carta documents an Investor API that lets fund operators retrieve summary cap table insights for their portfolio holdings directly (carta-docs-24, carta-docs-15), and personal-finance partners can aggregate equity holdings (carta-docs-26). Investors can therefore get holdings data from Carta without going through the founder, but only through API and integration paths. The evidence never describes an investor-facing portal UI or a structured update feed for investors. missing for 10: documented investor portal view of holdings, structured investor update/notification capability, coverage of individual (non-fund) investors, independent or hands-on corroboration.
